title: Raise the source_id capture budget from 8 s to 30 s
outcome: Raise the source_id capture budget from 8 s to 30 s
acceptance: `engram source` and the committed-input reader use a 30-second maximum budget instead of 8 seconds: src/source.rs MAX_BUDGET, the CLI `--timeout-ms` default and range in src/main.rs, the validation in src/committed_input.rs and the deadlines in src/committed_input/eol.rs
The launcher's source-owner call (scripts/review-freeze-fingerprint.mjs) allows the 30-second owner budget plus its existing startup margin
